name: Do finish carpenters also install kitchen cabinetry?

mainEntity.name: Do finish carpenters also install kitchen cabinetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some finish carpenters have the skills and experience to install kitchen cabinetry, it's often a distinct specialization. Many finish carpenters focus primarily on the decorative trim, molding, and custom woodwork that *enhances* installed cabinets, rather than the initial cabinet installation itself. Cabinet installation requires precise leveling and securing of units, which can be done by a dedicated cabinet installer or a general contractor's team. It's important to clarify with your chosen professional what their specific scope of work includes regarding cabinetry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Some finish carpenters install cabinetry, but many specialize in the decorative trim and custom work that enhances installed cabinets. Clarify their specific scope of work.
